cues.en: Hi, everyone. In this video, we'll be exploring a few potential methods to make paint that is capable of sub ambient
cues.zh: 大家好。在这个视频中，我们将探讨几种制作能够实现亚环境

cues.en: radiant cooling.
cues.zh: 辐射冷却的涂料的潜在方法。

cues.en: Basically, this paint could provide passive electricity
cues.zh: 基本上，这种涂料可以提供被动式、无需用电的

cues.en: free air conditioning
cues.zh: 空调效果，

cues.en: by sucking heat from its surroundings and hurling it into space as infrared radiation.
cues.zh: 通过吸收周围的热量，并将其以红外辐射的形式发射到太空中。

cues.en: As unbelievable as that sounds, there's a stack of published research documenting radiant paints that can reach temperatures as much as 10 degrees Celsius
cues.zh: 听起来可能有些难以置信，但已有大量发表的研究记录了这种辐射涂料，其温度可以比

cues.en: lower than the surrounding air temperature. There are a few different ways these paints have been made in the lab, and having gleaned what I can from half a dozen different papers, I think I've learned enough to make my own. We'll make two or three varieties in this video and test the cooling capability
cues.zh: 周围空气温度低多达 10 摄氏度。实验室里已经有几种不同的方法来制造这些涂料，在从大约六篇不同的论文中尽可能汲取知识后，我想我已经学到了足够的材料来自己动手制作。我们将在本视频中制作两到三种不同的品种，并测试其冷却能力，

cues.en: as compared to off the shelf white paint.
cues.zh: 与市面上的普通白漆进行对比。

cues.en: The first thing to consider is how this paint is meant to work. Its first attribute is to have extremely high reflectance of light in the visible spectrum.
cues.zh: 首先要考虑的是这种涂料的工作原理。它的第一个特性是对可见光谱中的光具有极高的反射率。

cues.en: A useful radiant paint should be able to maintain sub ambient temperatures
cues.zh: 一种实用的辐射涂料应该能够维持亚环境温度，

cues.en: even in direct sunlight,
cues.zh: 即使在直射阳光下也是如此，

cues.en: And that becomes more difficult for every bit of sunlight that the paint fails to reflect as the remainder is absorbed as heat.
cues.zh: 任何涂料未能反射的阳光都会作为热量被吸收，因此反射率越低，这项任务就越困难。

cues.en: Reflectance alone isn't adequate to provide cooling,
cues.zh: 单靠反射率并不足以实现冷却，

cues.en: but it gives us a good starting point.
cues.zh: 但它为我们提供了一个很好的起点。

cues.en: The real magic of radiative cooling is in the particular wavelength of infrared light that the paint emits.
cues.zh: 辐射冷却真正的奥妙在于涂料发射的特定波长的红外光。

cues.en: All objects emit their energy as infrared light, but for the most part that light is scattered around in the atmosphere, absorbed by atmospheric gases, and re emitted such that much of it returns back to earth to be reabsorbed.
cues.zh: 所有物体都会以红外光的形式辐射能量，但在很大程度上，这些光会在大气中散射、被大气气体吸收并再次发射，以至于其中大部分会返回地球并再次被吸收。

cues.en: It so happens that just a small sliver of the infrared spectrum passes clean through the atmosphere with little to no scattering.
cues.zh: 碰巧的是，红外光谱中只有很小的一段能够穿透大气层，几乎没有散射。

cues.en: This is called the atmospheric infrared window.
cues.zh: 这被称为大气红外窗口。

cues.en: If we can engineer the composition of our paint to release its thermal energy as infrared light at just the right wavelength, it will blow right through the atmosphere and off into the coldness of space.
cues.zh: 如果我们能够设计涂料的成分，使其以恰到好处的波长将热能释放为红外光，它就会直接冲破大气层，散逸到寒冷的太空中。

cues.en: By combining this emission of light with a strong rejection of incoming light in other spectrums,
cues.zh: 通过将这种光的发射与对其他光谱入射光的强烈反射结合起来，

cues.en: the overall effect is that the paint experiences a net loss of energy.
cues.zh: 总体效果就是涂料经历了净能量损失。

cues.en: It gets cold.
cues.zh: 它变冷了。

cues.en: The pigment in ordinary white paint that you can buy at a hardware store is usually titanium
cues.zh: 你在五金店能买到的普通白漆中的颜料通常是钛

cues.en: or zinc oxide.
cues.zh: 或氧化锌。

cues.en: These have great reflectance,
cues.zh: 它们的反射率极高，

cues.en: but they lack overlap in their emission spectrum with the atmospheric window.
cues.zh: 但它们的发射光谱与大气窗口缺乏重合。

cues.en: So far, best results in making sub ambient cooling paint have come from using one of two pigments,
cues.zh: 到目前为止，制造低于环境温度的冷却涂料的最佳效果来自于使用以下两种颜料之一：

cues.en: calcium carbonate or barium sulfate.
cues.zh: 碳酸钙或硫酸钡。

cues.en: Both of these are bright white with good reflectance,
cues.zh: 这两种颜料都呈现亮白色且具有良好的反射率，

cues.en: and most importantly,
cues.zh: 最重要的是，

cues.en: the infrared emission is right where we want it.
cues.zh: 它们的红外辐射正好位于我们想要的位置。

cues.en: Here in this container is a little bit of diluted sulfuric acid, and in this other one is barium nitrate dissolved in water.
cues.zh: 我手头这个容器里装的是一点稀硫酸，另一个容器里溶解的是硝酸钡水溶液。

cues.en: Mixing these two will form our pigment, barium sulfate, which is so insoluble it should immediately fall out of solution.
cues.zh: 混合这两种物质就能生成我们的颜料——硫酸钡，它极难溶解，应该会立刻从溶液中沉淀出来。

cues.en: It's actually a very pretty reaction.
cues.zh: 这其实是个很漂亮的反应。

cues.en: Now soluble barium compounds,
cues.zh: 现在来看可溶性钡化合物，

cues.en: like the barium nitrate that I started with in this container,
cues.zh: 比如我最初装在这个容器里的硝酸钡，

cues.en: are actually fairly toxic,
cues.zh: 其实毒性相当大，

cues.en: so I made sure there was more than enough sulfuric acid to react with all of it, and that takes care of the toxicity.
cues.zh: 所以我确保加入了足够过量的硫酸让它完全反应，这样就解决了毒性问题。

cues.en: The reaction is what's called a double displacement,
cues.zh: 这个反应叫做双置换反应，

cues.en: where the sulfuric part of the acid switches places with the nitrate part of the barium nitrate.
cues.zh: 酸中的硫酸根部分与硝酸钡中的硝酸根部分交换位置。

cues.en: In the end, we get a mix of barium sulfate, the insoluble pigment that we're looking for, and nitric acid in this beaker.
cues.zh: 最终，我们在这个烧杯中得到硫酸钡（我们要找的不溶性颜料）和硝酸的混合物。

cues.en: I wanna get rid of the acidity, so I'll add some concentrated ammonia,
cues.zh: 我想去掉酸性，所以加一些浓氨水，

cues.en: and this converts the nitric acid to ammonium
cues.zh: 这样就把硝酸转化成了硝酸铵。

cues.en: nitrate. Now the waste from this experiment will be a nice fertilizer for my trees instead of a dangerous acidic mess.
cues.zh: 现在这个实验的废液就成了我树木的好肥料，而不是危险的酸性废物。

cues.en: The barium sulfate formed by this reaction is really hard to collect with filtering because the particles are so fine they pass right through.
cues.zh: 这个反应生成的硫酸钡很难通过过滤收集，因为颗粒太细，会直接穿过滤纸。

cues.en: It's better to let them settle out and then pour the water off the top.
cues.zh: 更好的办法是让它们沉降下来，然后把上面的水倒掉。

cues.en: The last little bit of water can be removed by pouring the remainder onto a sheet of printer paper with paper towel underneath to gently suck the water through with capillary action.
cues.zh: 最后一点水可以通过把剩余物倒在铺了纸巾的打印纸上，利用毛细作用轻轻把水吸走。

cues.en: The paper contaminates the product slightly,
cues.zh: 纸会轻微污染产物，

cues.en: but the result is good enough for our purposes.
cues.zh: 但结果对我们的目的来说已经够好了。

cues.en: And here is our result,
cues.zh: 这是我们的结果，

cues.en: barium sulfate powder that we can mix with an acrylic base to form our paint.
cues.zh: 硫酸钡粉末，我们可以把它和丙烯酸基底混合制成涂料。

cues.en: Well, right away I've noticed a problem. This is a sample of 60%
cues.zh: 嗯，我马上发现了一个问题。这是一个样品，配比是60%

cues.en: transparent
cues.zh: 透明的

cues.en: acrylic base to 40%
cues.zh: 丙烯酸基底对40%

cues.en: barium sulfate pigment measured by weight.
cues.zh: 硫酸钡颜料，按重量计量。

cues.en: Let's brush this onto an object.
cues.zh: 我们把它刷到一个物体上试试。

cues.en: Do you see the problem?
cues.zh: 你看出问题了吗？

cues.en: There's a lot of transparency
cues.zh: 这涂料里有很强的透明感

cues.en: in this paint. For some reason, the barium sulfate becomes
cues.zh: 不知什么原因，硫酸钡在

cues.en: very transparent
cues.zh: 和液体混合后

cues.en: when mixed with a liquid.
cues.zh: 变得非常透明。

cues.en: I can see now why this is not used as a standard white pigment.
cues.zh: 我现在明白为什么它不被用作标准白色颜料了。

cues.en: In any case, I'll try applying multiple coats and see how close to pure white we can get.
cues.zh: 不管怎样，我会试着多涂几层，看看能多接近纯白。

cues.en: Here's a little setup I've put together to test the light rejection of our paint samples.
cues.zh: 这是我搭的一个小装置，用来测试涂料样品的反光能力。

cues.en: I have a light meter that is sealed to an outlet port on this circular chamber,
cues.zh: 我有一个光度计，密封在这个圆形腔体的一个出口端口上，

cues.en: and there's a focused beam of light coming in through another port and exiting through a slot in the side.
cues.zh: 还有一束聚焦的光从另一个端口射入，并从侧面的一个狭槽射出。

cues.en: Once I close off this open face, anything I put in front of the slot will reflect light back into the chamber and give us a brightness reading that is dependent on the total reflectance of the sample.
cues.zh: 一旦我把这个开口面封住，我放在狭槽前的任何东西都会把光反射回腔体，给我们一个取决于样品总反射率的亮度读数。

cues.en: I have a slide here that's been painted with off the shelf white paint, and using the reflectance of the light from this flashlight,
cues.zh: 我这里有一块载玻片，上面涂了市售的白漆，利用这个手电筒的反射光，

cues.en: we'll compare the reading with my homemade pigment.
cues.zh: 我们会把读数和我的自制颜料做比较。

cues.en: So there is our reading with standard ultra white paint, And switching in the barium sulfate sample,
cues.zh: 这就是标准超白漆的读数，然后换上硫酸钡样品，

cues.en: we get a lower reading,
cues.zh: 我们得到的读数更低，

cues.en: which is bad news.
cues.zh: 这可不是好消息。

cues.en: This means the light rejection is not as good for the homemade sample. And, therefore, even with the infrared emission,
cues.zh: 这意味着自制样品的抗光性没有那么好。因此，即使有红外辐射，

cues.en: it likely will not be able to cool objects
cues.zh: 它可能也无法冷却处于

cues.en: in direct sunlight.
cues.zh: 直射阳光下的物体。

cues.en: Well, after a few more experiments and failures to improve my results,
cues.zh: 好吧，在经过更多次实验以及未能改善结果的失败尝试后，

cues.en: I found an excellent paper describing a process to make barium sulfate
cues.zh: 我发现了一篇优秀的论文，描述了一种制作硫酸钡

cues.en: microspheres.
cues.zh: 微球的工艺。

cues.en: The goal of the paper seemed to be creating highly reflective coatings
cues.zh: 这篇论文的目标似乎是为医药产品

cues.en: for pharmaceutical products,
cues.zh: 制造高反射率涂层，

cues.en: which I guess matters for some reason. In any case, this sounded promising for my purposes.
cues.zh: 我猜这在某些方面很重要。无论如何，这对我的目的来说听起来很有希望。

cues.en: The previously used acid method of making barium sulfate is an extremely fast chemical reaction.
cues.zh: 先前使用酸法制作硫酸钡是一种极快的化学反应。

cues.en: Because the reaction happens so rapidly,
cues.zh: 由于反应发生得太快，

cues.en: the end product takes the form of amorphous blobs and random crystal structures.
cues.zh: 最终产物呈现出无定形团块和无规则的晶体结构。

cues.en: To form a particular particle shape, like microspheres,
cues.zh: 为了形成特定的颗粒形状（如微球），

cues.en: the reaction needs to take place in an orderly fashion, with controlled nucleation points.
cues.zh: 反应需要有序地进行，并具有受控的成核点。

cues.en: The way this is accomplished is by using another chemical in the solution that temporarily bonds with the dissolved barium
cues.zh: 实现这一点的方法是在溶液中使用另一种化学物质，它能与溶解的钡暂时结合，

cues.en: so there's some hesitation before they react.
cues.zh: 这样它们在反应前就会有一定的延迟。

cues.en: The delay is imperceptible to the eye, but it's enough to allow the crystals to nucleate from a billion little points, and then continue growing outward at a steady rate in all directions,
cues.zh: 这种延迟肉眼察觉不到，但它足以让晶体从十亿个微小的点开始成核，然后以稳定的速率向各个方向继续生长，

cues.en: forming spheres.
cues.zh: 从而形成球体。

cues.en: The chemical used to inhibit the reaction is called EDTA,
cues.zh: 用于抑制反应的化学物质叫做EDTA，

cues.en: which I mix into my soluble barium solution.
cues.zh: 我把它混入我的可溶性钡溶液中。

cues.en: No measurements were given in the paper I was referencing for this process,
cues.zh: 我参考的那篇论文里并没有给出这个工艺的具体测量数据，

cues.en: so I guess a molar equivalent with the barium should be about right.
cues.zh: 所以我猜用等摩尔量的钡应该就差不多了。

cues.en: I tried half a dozen times to make this reaction work with barium nitrate
cues.zh: 我尝试过好几次用硝酸钡作为起始化学品来让这个反应进行，

cues.en: as my starting chemical because I have a lot of it, and it's fairly inexpensive.
cues.zh: 因为我手里有很多硝酸钡，而且它相当便宜。

cues.en: This, however, seemed to cause a weird side reaction with the EDTA,
cues.zh: 然而，这似乎引发了与EDTA的一个奇怪的副反应，

cues.en: forming a sticky substance which was completely inseparable from my barium sulfate end product.
cues.zh: 形成了一种黏性物质，完全无法从我的硫酸钡最终产物中分离出来。

cues.en: You can see it caused a brown tint to the light that passes through a solution of the resulting microspheres,
cues.zh: 你可以看到，这让透过生成的微球溶液的光线带上了一层棕色，

cues.en: and I could not get rid of it no matter how many times I washed the particles with water and every other solvent I could think to try.
cues.zh: 无论我用清水以及我能想到的所有其他溶剂把这些颗粒洗多少次，我都无法除掉它。

cues.en: I even bought a centrifuge to separate and wash the particles more easily,
cues.zh: 我甚至买了一台离心机来更轻松地分离和清洗这些颗粒，

cues.en: because unlike the acid formed barium sulfate, the microspheres
cues.zh: 因为与酸形成的硫酸钡不同，这些微球

cues.en: never seemed to settle to the bottom.
cues.zh: 似乎从来不会沉淀到底部。

cues.en: When separated by a centrifuge, the result was a gelatinous and still transparent pile of muck at the bottom of the tube, retaining the brown tint of the nitrate side reaction.
cues.zh: 用离心机分离后，结果是管底堆积了一堆呈胶状且仍然透明的污泥，并保留了硝酸钡副反应带来的棕色。

cues.en: My problems were eventually solved by exchanging
cues.zh: 我的问题最终通过将

cues.en: the barium nitrate
cues.zh: 硝酸钡

cues.en: for barium chloride,
cues.zh: 替换为氯化钡而得到了解决，

cues.en: which left the EDTA in a soluble state.
cues.zh: 这使得EDTA保持在可溶状态。

cues.en: Instead of sulfuric acid, this reaction uses sodium sulfate
cues.zh: 这个反应没有使用硫酸，而是使用硫酸钠

cues.en: as the contributor of the sulfate ion.
cues.zh: 作为硫酸根离子的提供者。

cues.en: When the sulfate and chloride swap places,
cues.zh: 当硫酸根和氯离子互换位置后，

cues.en: we end up with sodium chloride, ordinary table salt in solution, and barium sulfate, hopefully in the form of microspheres.
cues.zh: 我们得到的溶液中就会含有氯化钠（也就是普通的食盐），以及希望是以微球形态存在的硫酸钡。

cues.en: Constant stirring and slow combination of the two liquids is needed to form microspheres
cues.zh: 需要不断搅拌并缓慢混合这两种液体，才能形成

cues.en: of a consistent size.
cues.zh: 尺寸均匀的微球。

cues.en: But in the case of paint, the best reflectivity
cues.zh: 但对于涂料而言，最佳的反射率

cues.en: comes from a variety of particle sizes.
cues.zh: 往往来自于各种不同大小的颗粒。

cues.en: Fortunately, that's easy to accomplish.
cues.zh: 幸运的是，这很容易做到。

cues.en: No stirring and a quick addition.
cues.zh: 无需搅拌，快速加入即可。

cues.en: Without the nitrate to form a weird gel, the spheres do eventually settle to the bottom of this container by gravity alone,
cues.zh: 如果没有硝酸盐形成奇怪的凝胶，这些微球最终确实会仅靠重力沉降到这个容器的底部，

cues.en: but much more slowly than the acid made pigment.
cues.zh: 但比酸制颜料的速度慢得多。

cues.en: My earlier centrifuge purchase still ended up being helpful for this purpose, as I can reduce the settling time from a few hours to just a few minutes at 4,000.
cues.zh: 我之前买的离心机在这个环节最终还是派上了用场，在 4,000 转下，我可以把沉降时间从几个小时缩短到短短几分钟。

cues.en: Repeating this a few times, each time pouring off the liquid and adding fresh distilled water, leaves fairly pure barium sulfate,
cues.zh: 重复几次，每次倒掉液体并加入新鲜的蒸馏水，就能得到相当纯净的硫酸钡，

cues.en: hopefully now in a state that is much more reflective and less transparent
cues.zh: 希望它现在的状态能比

cues.en: than the earlier amorphous particles.
cues.zh: 早期的无定形颗粒更具反射性、透明度更低。

cues.en: So here I have a sample slide of my microsphere paint, and this is my earlier made amorphous barium sulfate paint.
cues.zh: 所以这里我有一张我的微球涂料样品载玻片，这是我之前制作的无定形硫酸钡涂料。

cues.en: And I have to say, visibly, the difference is not as dramatic as I had hoped.
cues.zh: 我不得不说，从肉眼来看，差距并没有我希望的那么戏剧化。

cues.en: Although there is a difference. This is brighter white.
cues.zh: 尽管确实有区别。这个白色更亮。

cues.en: I've let these dry so that we can now take a look under the light meter.
cues.zh: 我已经把它们晾干了，现在我们可以用光度计来看一下。

cues.en: So the microsphere paint does read a little bit better,
cues.zh: 所以微球涂料的读数确实稍微好一点，

cues.en: but it still has some obvious transparency.
cues.zh: 但它仍然有明显的透明感。

cues.en: Since multiple papers report using barium sulfate in these paints, there must be some unmentioned secret sauce that's being used to reduce the transparency.
cues.zh: 既然有多篇论文报道在这些涂料中使用了硫酸钡，那肯定有什么没提及的独家秘方被用来降低透明度。

cues.en: My initial thoughts are that perhaps the barium pigment is being mixed with a standard titanium or zinc based paint,
cues.zh: 我最初的想法是，也许是把钡颜料和标准的钛基或锌基油漆混在一起了，

cues.en: or perhaps the barium paint is only used as a top coat over a layer of opaque white paint beneath it. Both of these options seem less than ideal. I think achieving the best result will require a new approach entirely.
cues.zh: 或者这种钡基油漆只是作为底层不透明白漆之上的面漆使用。这两种选择看起来都不太理想。我认为要取得最佳效果，必须采用全新的方法。

cues.en: One method to make ultra white coatings without the use of pigments is to replicate the same mechanism which is responsible for the highly reflective properties
cues.zh: 不用颜料制作超白涂层的方法之一，是复制赋予雪高反射率的同款机制，

cues.en: of snow.
cues.zh: 也就是雪。

cues.en: Snow is remarkable because while it's made of transparent ice,
cues.zh: 雪很神奇，因为虽然它由透明的冰组成，

cues.en: it somehow manages to reject and reflect over 98%
cues.zh: 却能反射和拒绝超过 98%

cues.en: of incoming sunlight,
cues.zh: 的入射阳光，

cues.en: making it even more reflective than almost all white paint.
cues.zh: 这使得它的反射率甚至超过了几乎所有的白漆。

cues.en: It does this with an enormous amount of small air pockets, which cause any light that passes through to stand a pretty good chance of hitting mirror like surfaces of the ice crystals.
cues.zh: 它通过大量微小的气隙来实现这一点，这使得任何穿过其中的光线都有很大几率击中冰晶镜面般的表面。

cues.en: Any light that makes it through one air gap soon hits another, and another, and another, until almost all of it ends up being reflected back where it came from.
cues.zh: 任何穿过一个气隙的光很快就会击中另一个、再一个、又一个，直到几乎所有的光最终都被反射回它来的地方。

cues.en: This effect can be roughly imitated with any transparent solid.
cues.zh: 这种效果可以用任何透明固体大致模仿。

cues.en: For example, table salt, which on a close-up view is made up of transparent crystals,
cues.zh: 例如食盐，近看是由透明晶体组成的，

cues.en: but get a whole pile of them together with air gaps in between, and the pile appears white.
cues.zh: 但如果把一堆食盐聚在一起，中间留有气隙，这堆食盐就会呈现白色。

cues.en: To make use of this snow scattering effect in a way that's practical for a painted surface,
cues.zh: 为了在涂漆表面上以实用 的方式利用这种雪的散射效果，

cues.en: we're looking to achieve the maximum amount of air gaps in the thinnest layer possible.
cues.zh: 我们需要在尽可能薄的层中实现最大数量的气隙。

cues.en: One method I found described in yet another article uses a clever series of physical reactions.
cues.zh: 我在另一篇文章里看到的一种方法，利用了一系列巧妙的物理反应。

cues.en: First dissolving an exotic plastic in acetone,
cues.zh: 首先把一种特种塑料溶解在丙酮里，

cues.en: then adding a small amount of water.
cues.zh: 然后加入少量的水。

cues.en: When this dissolved plastic mixture dries,
cues.zh: 当这种溶解后的塑料混合物干燥时，

cues.en: the acetone evaporates first,
cues.zh: 丙酮会先蒸发，

cues.en: leaving behind a layer of plastic which is completely permeated with microscopic water droplets.
cues.zh: 留下一层完全渗满微观水滴的塑料层。

cues.en: When the water dries, we're left with millions of tiny, regularly spaced cavities in the plastic.
cues.zh: 当水分干燥后，我们就在塑料里得到了数百万个微小且排列规则的空洞。

cues.en: While the paper describing this process used an exotic and expensive plastic,
cues.zh: 虽然描述这个工艺的论文使用的是一种奇特且昂贵的塑料，

cues.en: I was able to replicate their results with ordinary transparent acrylic,
cues.zh: 但我用普通的透明亚克力成功复制了他们的结果，

cues.en: which dissolves in acetone after a few days.
cues.zh: 这种亚克力在几天后就会溶于水。

cues.en: Now, you can't just add water directly to this solution of dissolved acrylic, because the water causes the plastic to crash out of solution instantly,
cues.zh: 现在，你不能直接把水加到这个溶解的亚克力溶液里，因为水会导致塑料瞬间从溶液中析出，

cues.en: forming little plastic jellyfish blobs with the water sealed inside.
cues.zh: 形成里面包裹着水分的小塑料水母状团块。

cues.en: I found the best way to introduce water is to first mix it in a one to four ratio with acetone.
cues.zh: 我发现引入水分的最佳方法是先将其与丙酮按一比四的比例混合。

cues.en: So point one mil of water is added for every point five mils of this solution.
cues.zh: 也就是每零点五毫升这种溶液加入零点一毫升的水。

cues.en: So let's give this a try. If I've added enough water, the dissolved acrylic should go on clear and then turn white as it dries.
cues.zh: 那我们来试试看。如果我加的水够多，溶解的亚克力涂上去时应该是透明的，然后在干燥时变成白色。

cues.en: Pretty neat stuff, isn't it? We can make really highly reflective surfaces this way with minimal effort and low cost.
cues.zh: 挺酷的对吧？用这种方法，我们可以花极少的成本、费最少的力气，做出反射率极高的表面。

cues.en: However, in terms of the infrared emission spectrum,
cues.zh: 然而，就红外发射光谱而言，

cues.en: it's not suitable for cooling.
cues.zh: 它并不适合用于冷却。

cues.en: For sub ambient temperatures, we still need the barium sulfate or some other pigment that hits the infrared window.
cues.zh: 对于低于环境温度的情况，我们仍然需要硫酸钡或其他能命中红外窗口的颜料。

cues.en: My idea at this point is to combine the brightest of my barium pigments, my sulfate microspheres,
cues.zh: 我现在的想法是把最亮的钡颜料——我的硫酸钡微球——结合起来，

cues.en: with the acrylic acetone mix. If all goes well, the snow scattering effect of the acrylic will aid in light rejection and opacity where the barium sulfate falls short, and the barium sulfate will contribute favorable emission.
cues.zh: 与丙烯酸-丙酮混合液混合。如果一切顺利，丙烯酸的雪散射效应会在硫酸钡不足的地方帮助拒光和提高不透明度，而硫酸钡会贡献有利的发射性能。

cues.en: First of all, here is a test of various water ratios in the acrylic base.
cues.zh: 首先，这里测试丙烯酸基底中不同的水比例。

cues.en: I dissolved 10 grams of acrylic in a 100 mils of acetone,
cues.zh: 我把10克丙烯酸溶解在100毫升丙酮中，

cues.en: so I know there's one gram of plastic for every 10 mils of this solution.
cues.zh: 所以我知道这种溶液每10毫升含1克塑料。

cues.en: This allows me a controlled way to add incremental amounts of water, and find out just how much should be added per gram of plastic for the best result.
cues.zh: 这样我就能可控地逐步加水，并找出每克塑料加多少水效果最好。

cues.en: Between point five and point six mils of water per gram of plastic gave me good reflectance in this test, with minor loss of adhesion and contraction.
cues.zh: 在这个测试中，每克塑料加0.5到0.6毫升水，反射率不错，附着力和收缩只有轻微损失。

cues.en: Later, when I opened a brand new can of acetone, I found that I had to double the amount of water added to achieve the same result, so apparently my old can absorbed quite a lot of water from the air with age.
cues.zh: 后来我打开一罐全新的丙酮，发现要达到同样效果得把加水量翻倍，所以显然我的旧罐子随时间从空气里吸收了不少水分。

cues.en: Once I determined the best results without pigment,
cues.zh: 一旦确定了不加颜料时的最佳结果，

cues.en: I did a few tests with added barium sulfate. Two grams of sulfate for one gram dissolved acrylic.
cues.zh: 我就做了几次添加硫酸钡的测试。每1克溶解的丙烯酸用2克硫酸钡。

cues.en: So, here is a test slide with the best result
cues.zh: 这是效果最好的测试样片

cues.en: of my combinations,
cues.zh: 来自我的各种组合，

cues.en: and to my eyes, this looks significantly brighter than off the shelf paint.
cues.zh: 在我看来，它比市售涂料亮得多。

cues.en: If the reflectance test agrees, and if there's enough pigment for good infrared emission, I think there's a good chance that this will work. So, let's give this a try.
cues.zh: 如果反射率测试也吻合，而且颜料足够多、能有良好的红外发射，我觉得它很可能有效。那就试试吧。

cues.en: That is looking significantly
cues.zh: 这看起来明显

cues.en: better than my earlier attempts.
cues.zh: 比我之前的尝试好多了。

cues.en: The snow scattering effect seems to be really effective.
cues.zh: 雪散射效应似乎非常有效。

cues.en: Here's off the shelf paint
cues.zh: 这是市售涂料

cues.en: and my paint.
cues.zh: 这是我的涂料。

cues.en: This might be a big enough difference to offer some cooling in sunlight.
cues.zh: 这个差异可能足够大，能在阳光下带来一些降温。

cues.en: So, here is my first full size test sample with ordinary white paint as the background of the square and an x in the center, which is my snow scattering paint.
cues.zh: 这是我第一个全尺寸测试样品：方块背景是普通白漆，中心是一个 X，用的是我的雪散射涂料。

cues.en: The x was painted right onto the wooden subsurface with the off the shelf paint painted around it, so that it would not be a double layer, which might make an unfair test.
cues.zh: X 直接涂在木质底面上，周围涂的是市售涂料，这样就不会形成双层，避免测试不公平。

cues.en: Now, I've made an awkward infrared camera rig with dual split lens filters on my camera, so that I can get both close focus on the infrared camera,
cues.zh: 现在我做了一个笨拙的红外相机装置，在相机上装了双分光滤镜，这样我既能近距对焦红外相机，

cues.en: and distant focus simultaneously.
cues.zh: 又能同时让远处对焦。

cues.en: Hopefully, I'll also not overexpose the bright daylight landscape.
cues.zh: 希望我也不会把明亮的白天风景拍过曝。

cues.en: Using this, let's take a look at my test sample after leaving it out in the sun for a few minutes.
cues.zh: 用它来看看，我把测试样品放在太阳下几分钟后的情况。

cues.en: And here we do have a successful result.
cues.zh: 结果确实成功了。

cues.en: Clearly,
cues.zh: 很明显，

cues.en: my paint is substantially cooler than the surrounding ordinary paint.
cues.zh: 我的涂料比周围的普通涂料凉快得多。

cues.en: But is it subambient?
cues.zh: 但这是低于环境温度吗？

cues.en: Not quite. The air temperature was about 65 degrees at this time, so we're close.
cues.zh: 不完全是。当时气温大约是华氏65度，所以我们很接近了。

cues.en: But direct sunlight is the most difficult scenario for radiant paint.
cues.zh: 但直射阳光是辐射涂料最难应对的场景。

cues.en: The best recorded results are only a few degrees cooler than ambient temperatures in direct sunlight,
cues.zh: 直射阳光下最佳记录结果也只是比环境温度低几度，

cues.en: so to even get close with my DIY methods is satisfying.
cues.zh: 所以用我的DIY方法能接近这个水平已经很令人满意了。

cues.en: I think it's safe to say this is better cooling than you can probably get with any other paint currently available for purchase.
cues.zh: 可以说，这比目前市面上能买到的任何其他涂料冷却效果都要好。

cues.en: Even so, sub ambient temperatures are important for this to be useful.
cues.zh: 即便如此，低于环境温度对其实用性很重要。

cues.en: Fortunately, noonday sun is only around for a small sliver of the day. Let's try some tests with indirect sunlight and see if we can hit sub ambient numbers.
cues.zh: 幸运的是，正午阳光一天中只出现一小段时间。让我们试试间接阳光下的测试，看看能否达到低于环境温度的数据。

cues.en: This next test brought some unexpected results.
cues.zh: 接下来的测试带来了一些意外结果。

cues.en: My paint is currently a few degrees colder than air temperature here in the shade,
cues.zh: 我的涂料在阴凉处比气温低几度，

cues.en: sub ambient.
cues.zh: 低于环境温度。

cues.en: But so is the commercial paint.
cues.zh: 但商用涂料也是如此。

cues.en: My paint might be slightly colder, but not substantially.
cues.zh: 我的涂料可能稍冷一点，但差别不大。

cues.en: In direct sunlight,
cues.zh: 在直射阳光下，

cues.en: it's obvious that my paint is significantly better than ordinary ultra white, but I didn't expect the off the shelf paint to be so close in performance
cues.zh: 很明显我的涂料比普通超白涂料好得多，但我没想到现成涂料性能如此接近

cues.en: once direct light was gone. Despite not matching with the infrared window, it seems normal titanium based paints
cues.zh: 一旦直射光消失。尽管与红外窗口不匹配，普通钛基涂料

cues.en: can work pretty well for sub ambient nighttime cooling.
cues.zh: 似乎也能很好地实现夜间低于环境温度的冷却。

cues.en: Still, barium should be able to do much better, so all I can think is that I've not added enough pigment.
cues.zh: 不过，钡应该能做得更好，所以我想只是我加的颜料不够多。

cues.en: I thought two grams of pigment for each gram of dissolved acrylic was pretty generous, but apparently more is needed. Here I have a four to one mix, and in this jar, six grams of pigment to each gram of dissolved acrylic.
cues.zh: 我原本觉得每克溶解的丙烯酸树脂加两克颜料已经相当慷慨了，但显然还需要更多。这里我配了一个四比一的混合物，而这个罐子里，则是每克溶解的丙烯酸树脂对应六克颜料。

cues.en: You would think that adding so much would get in the way of the snow scattering effect, but both of these mixes seem to work just fine,
cues.zh: 你可能会觉得加这么多会影响雪花散射效果，但这两种混合物看起来效果都挺好，

cues.en: and actually read a fair bit more reflective than my original two to one mix.
cues.zh: 而且实际上比我最初的二比一混合物看起来反光效果要好不少。

cues.en: In outdoor testing, the four to one mixture proved to be significantly better at daylight cooling than the two to one mix, and the six to one was even better still, but just by a few fractions of a degree.
cues.zh: 在户外测试中，四比一的混合物在日间降温效果上明显优于二比一的混合物，而六比一的效果还要更好，不过仅仅领先了零点几度。

cues.en: This could maybe use a little bit of fine tuning to dial in on the perfect mixture, but the four to one paint variation is what I used to make this sign,
cues.zh: 这可能还需要一点微调来找到完美的配方，不过我用四比一的油漆变体制作了这个标牌，

cues.en: the result of which, I think, speaks for itself.
cues.zh: 我想，最终的效果是不言而喻的。

cues.en: The lettering is my homemade paint, surrounded by off the shelf ultra white, which clocks in at a full 20 degrees Fahrenheit warmer after a few minutes in the sun.
cues.zh: 上面的字是用我自制的油漆写的，周围则是市面上买得到的超白漆，在阳光下晒了几分钟后，它的温度直接高出了整整 20 华氏度。

cues.en: That is an incredible difference in temperature for two paints of the same color.
cues.zh: 对于两种颜色相同的油漆来说，这是一个惊人的温差。

cues.en: My paint is still reading slightly above air temperature, but just barely.
cues.zh: 我的油漆读数仍然略高于气温，但也只是高了一点点。

cues.en: I think it would be sub ambient if it were not fighting the heat conduction from the surrounding paint.
cues.zh: 我觉得要不是在对抗周围油漆传导过来的热量，它本可以达到低于环境温度的效果。

cues.en: Strangely,
cues.zh: 奇怪的是，

cues.en: even with this great daytime result, I found that once the sun went down, both the commercial paint and my own were still neck and neck for sub ambient temperatures.
cues.zh: 尽管白天取得了如此出色的降温效果，我发现一旦太阳落山，市售油漆和我的油漆在低于环境温度方面的表现依然不相上下。

cues.en: Both paints in this shot were reading below 65 degrees,
cues.zh: 这一镜头中的两种涂料读数都低于 65 度，

cues.en: while the air temperature was 85.
cues.zh: 而气温是 85 度。

cues.en: This is a great result for both paints. I have to say I did not expect ordinary white paint to perform so well. It's terrible during daylight hours, but it does have cooling potential at night.
cues.zh: 这对这两种涂料来说都是个好结果。我得说，我没想到普通白漆的表现能这么好。它在白天效果很糟糕，但夜间确实有降温潜力。

cues.en: Now since I tested so many different paints,
cues.zh: 既然我测试了这么多不同的涂料，

cues.en: I got tired of making my own barium sulfate and ended up just buying some. Theoretically, microspheres
cues.zh: 我厌倦了自己制作硫酸钡，最后干脆买了一些。理论上讲，微球

cues.en: should do even better than this store bought amorphous powder, but since the snow scattering acrylic mix is the primary reflecting agent of this paint, added reflection from the pigment is just a bonus.
cues.zh: 的表现应该比这种买来的无定形粉末更好，但既然雪花散射丙烯酸混合物是这款涂料的主要反射剂，颜料带来的额外反射只是锦上添花。

cues.en: Obviously, the paint works even with this amorphous pigment, which is great news for ease of manufacturing.
cues.zh: 很明显，即使使用这种无定形颜料，涂料也能起作用，这对简化制造过程是个好消息。

cues.en: Now at this point, having so far only matched air temperature in direct sunlight,
cues.zh: 现在说到这里，此前在直射阳光下只做到了与气温持平，

cues.en: I reread some of the articles about how sub ambient temperatures have been reached by others and realized most daylight cooling requires putting a film over the top of the paint to insulate it from the heat conduction of the wind.
cues.zh: 我重新阅读了一些关于其他人是如何实现低于环境温度的文章，并意识到大多数日间降温都需要在涂料表面覆上一层薄膜，将其与风带来的热传导隔离开来。

cues.en: A thin polyethylene film apparently works well, and allows infrared light to pass through it.
cues.zh: 一层薄薄的聚乙烯薄膜显然效果很好，并且能让红外线穿透。

cues.en: I used this little tray to hold two samples of paint, my paint, and off the shelf paint, with a thin film stretched over the top to insulate the samples.
cues.zh: 我用这个小盘子盛放两个涂料样品——我的涂料和市售涂料，并在顶部拉上一层薄膜来对样品进行隔热。

cues.en: With this, finally,
cues.zh: 有了这个，终于，

cues.en: we get some daylight cooling.
cues.zh: 我们实现了日间降温。

cues.en: My first test in this tray gave us about two degrees Fahrenheit below ambient.
cues.zh: 我在这个托盘里做的第一次测试，让温度比环境温度低了大约两华氏度。

cues.en: This was in direct noonday sunlight.
cues.zh: 这是在正午直射的阳光下测得的。

cues.en: So even though it's only a few degrees of cooling, it's cooling that could be counted on even in very unfavorable conditions.
cues.zh: 所以，尽管只有几度的降温，但在非常不利的条件下这也是可以指望的冷却效果。

cues.en: Added to 20 plus degrees of cooling below air temperature at night, it's not hard to think of ways that this could be used to keep something cold all day long.
cues.zh: 再加上夜间比气温低 20 多度的冷却效果，不难想到可以用这种方法让物体整天保持冰凉。

cues.en: For example, by cooling a building to 20 degrees below air temperature at night, so it lasts through the next day like a giant thermal battery.
cues.zh: 例如，在夜间把建筑物冷却到比气温低 20 度，这样它就能像一个巨大的蓄热电池一样撑过第二天。

cues.en: By the time it approaches air temperature, the sun is setting again, and a new cooling cycle begins.
cues.zh: 等到它快要回升到气温时，太阳又落山了，新的冷却循环开始了。

cues.en: Now the way that I have these samples set up in this tray is actually a close approximation
cues.zh: 现在，我把这些样品放在这个托盘里的方式，实际上非常接近

cues.en: to how radiative cooling is most likely to find practical use.
cues.zh: 辐射冷却最可能获得实际应用的场景。

cues.en: Not by directly painting buildings,
cues.zh: 不是直接涂在建筑物上，

cues.en: because they would become too cold in winter,
cues.zh: 因为那样在冬天会变得太冷，

cues.en: but rather to make cooling panels that cycle water or air through them only when cooling is needed.
cues.zh: 而是制作冷却面板，只在需要冷却时才让水或空气在其中循环。

cues.en: Some companies have already developed cooling panels and even installed them in limited test cases,
cues.zh: 一些公司已经开发了冷却面板，甚至在有限的测试中进行了安装，

cues.en: But as far as I've found, no one has yet made them available for normal purchase.
cues.zh: 但据我所知，还没有人将它们投入普通市场销售。

cues.en: I would very much like to make and test my own panels that could potentially be recreated by anyone at home.
cues.zh: 我非常想制作并测试我自己的面板，让任何人都能在家里复刻。

cues.en: This paint is a really good start, but I could easily double this video length just by discussing ideas to improve it. No promises, but I think we're looking at a series.
cues.zh: 这种漆是一个很好的开始，但我光是讨论改进它的点子就能把这个视频长度翻倍。不敢保证，但我觉得我们要出一系列视频了。

cues.en: This video sponsor is Brilliant.
cues.zh: 本视频的赞助商是 Brilliant。

cues.en: I am really selective about the companies that sponsor these videos, but I keep going back to Brilliant because I so appreciate the way that they approach education.
cues.zh: 我对赞助这些视频的公司一向非常挑剔，但我一直与 Brilliant 合作，因为我太喜欢他们的教育理念了。

cues.en: Brilliant specializes in teaching STEM topics through interactive and visually intuitive courses,
cues.zh: Brilliant 专注于通过互动且直观可视的课程来教授 STEM 学科，

cues.en: which really makes the information stick in your mind. You can learn anything from basic math and logic to special relativity
cues.zh: 这真的能让知识深深印在你的脑海里。你可以学习从基础数学、逻辑到狭义相对论的各种内容，

cues.en: with everything in between.
cues.zh: 以及介于两者之间的所有知识。

cues.en: When I work on projects like this one, I use a lot of measurements in percentages and parts,
cues.zh: 当我制作像这样的项目时，我会用到很多关于百分比和部件的测量数据，

cues.en: which is very important for being able to replicate the results consistently.
cues.zh: 这对于能够持续稳定地复现结果非常重要。

cues.en: If you have trouble making sense of those things, activate a free trial of Brilliant and check out their new course on everyday math.
cues.zh: 如果你觉得理解这些内容有困难，可以开通 Brilliant 的免费试用，去看看他们关于日常数学的新课程。

cues.en: It starts with very simple visual problems that you can go through at your own pace.
cues.zh: 它从非常简单的视觉化问题开始，你可以按照自己的节奏学习。

cues.en: Their courses on logic and probability
cues.zh: 他们关于逻辑和概率的课程

cues.en: are some of my favorites as well. There's tons of other courses for anyone who would like to learn something new.
cues.zh: 也是我的最爱之一。这里还有大量其他课程，适合任何想学点新东西的人。

cues.en: To get started for free, go to brilliant.org/nighthawk
cues.zh: 要免费开始学习，请访问 brilliant.org/nighthawk

cues.en: or click the link in the video description below, and the first 200 will get 20% off Brilliant's annual premium subscription.
cues.zh: 或点击下方视频简介中的链接，前 200 名用户将享受 Brilliant 年度高级订阅八折优惠。

cues.en: Now I realize it has been a long time since my previous video. I've had some minor but annoyingly long lasting health issues that slowed me down this last year. Thanks for sticking with me, especially those of you who support these videos on Patreon.
cues.zh: 现在我意识到距离我上一期视频已经过去很久了。过去这一年，我有一些虽小但却持续时间烦人的健康问题，这拖慢了我的进度。谢谢大家一直以来的陪伴，尤其是那些在 Patreon 上支持这些视频的朋友们。

cues.en: I'll probably be slow in posting new videos for a few months still,
cues.zh: 接下来几个月，我发布新视频可能还是会比较慢，

cues.en: but I am working on projects in the background. There's lots I'm excited to show you. I'm excited to keep improving on this radiant paint,
cues.zh: 但我在幕后推进一些项目。有很多东西我很想展示给你们。我也很期待继续改进这个 Radiant Paint，

cues.en: and I hope you've enjoyed this video.
cues.zh: 希望你们喜欢这期视频。

cues.en: Thanks for watching.
cues.zh: 感谢观看。

cues.en: I'll see you next time.
cues.zh: 我们下次见。
